ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its blues guitar focus fits my recent interest in Memphis and People, Hell & Angels, so I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soul City; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize this release well enough to choose it from the title alone.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rhythm & Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues direction appeals to me, but I would spend this visit on my strongest matches.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for its close connection to Clapton and relaxed roots music.
ItemID: NA; Title: 4.5; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title gives me too little information to connect it with my current listening interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Every Time Two Fools Collide; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic country duets are less appealing to me right now than blues and roots rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric, largely instrumental rock is not what I am looking for on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its roots-oriented country sound could suit me, but I am not interested enough to choose another album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Bang Bang Boom Boom; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-oriented vocals and rock energy fit my recent listening, though my other choices feel more immediate.
ItemID: NA; Title: Boys & Girls; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its soulful roots-rock sound interests me, but I would stick with the two albums I most want to hear.
